data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 557 closed 2019 with opening (2018) gross claims outstanding of GBP 31.399m and reported releases on prior year catastrophe items. The managing agent states the Syndicate "benefited from GBP 2.3 million of releases on prior year catastrophe events including the California Wildfires and Superstorm Sandy", indicating a favourable prior-year reserve development. The Syndicate writes primarily reinsurance business (quota share of property catastrophe risk) so the release is attributed to prior catastrophe claims experience re-assessment in the reinsurance/property book.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development amount used is the managing agent's narrative statement of GBP 2.3m releases (page 7). The report does not present an explicit GROSS total prior-year movement in a single labelled 'movement in prior year's provision' gross column for Syndicate 557 that was readily extractable from the images; the GBP 2.3m figure may represent catastrophe-related releases (possible net or gross ambiguity). A gross claims development triangle exists (page 58) but was not fully parsed from the scanned images - therefore the prior year development value is taken from narrative (confidence moderate). If a precise gross prior-year movement is required, consult the gross movement column in the detailed reserves note/triangle on page 58 or the statutory 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note.
